snippet.title: PlayStation - Asuncia - Matsue no Jubaku (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Asuncia: Matsue no Jubaku is a Role-Playing game, developed by E.O. Imagination and published by Xing Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1997.
